extraction: Supplement embedded geometry-data JSON; source coordinate values independently checked against original report; only selected-layer secondary-confirmation points exported.

pointMapping.sampleId: Consistently anonymized paired trajectory identifier from the supplement

layerNumbering: layer is one-based (L13 / L31); internalIndex is zero-based (12 / 30).

modes: Thinking: strict indexed numeric trace item-end state
condition.subset: 10 paired complete trajectories, 100 states per mode, secondary confirmation

selectionRule: Each mode independently maximizes discovery grouped-out-of-fold NCC balanced accuracy; ties use discovery logistic balanced accuracy, then earlier layer. Confirmation is not used for layer selection.
pca: PCA fitted separately on discovery states for each mode and layer. Stored coordinates of first three components are retained exactly; no refitting or inference.
centroids: Arithmetic means of the displayed 10 secondary-confirmation states at each running index. Connecting these means is a descriptive centroid path, not a single observed trajectory or classifier centers.
classifier: Saved secondary-confirmation nearest-centroid balanced accuracy after whitened 16-component PCA. Chance is 10%. Not a classifier fit in the displayed 3D coordinates.
cohortCaveat: Selected complete strict indexed numeric traces; 30 paired trajectories total (20 secondary discovery, 10 secondary confirmation). All 11 original discovery seeds are retained; 10 of 19 original confirmation seeds are hash-selected as secondary confirmation; the remaining 9 are added to secondary discovery. Trace-format selection and the secondary split followed exploration, so this is not a fresh confirmatory cohort or the full output population.
displayCaveat: PCA bases and signs can differ across modes; shared camera is not shared coordinates. If independently centered and fitted, cloud size must not be interpreted as comparable absolute magnitudes.
